about: Held-out set 2 (EN): synthetic history of Ridgeway Fix, the repair-booking and parts site of a fictional community bike co-op in Millbrook (Oct 2026). Coordinator Maya, mechanic Tom (editor), volunteers. Written for the T4 held-out run without reading eval/t4 results, eval/dev or eval/heldout cases.

steps.content:
# Ridgeway Fix prices (October 2026)

Membership: $40 per year.
Tune-up: members $25, non-members $45.
Parts: inner tube $6, brake pads $9 a pair, chain $18.
Labour for other repairs is quoted at the stand.
steps.name: pricing.md

steps.content:
# Workshop hours

Tuesday and Thursday 17:00-20:00 (booked repairs).
Saturday 10:00-16:00 (booked repairs and walk-ins).
Closed on public holidays.
steps.name: hours.md

steps.content:
# Safety and workshop policy

- Riders under 16 need a parent or guardian present at the stand.
- We do not open or repair e-bike batteries; we refer people to a battery specialist.
- Bikes left more than 60 days after a completed repair are donated to the youth programme after two reminder SMS.
- Closed-toe shoes in the workshop.
steps.name: safety-policy.md

steps.label: Ridgeway Fix: booking flow
events: We're building the booking page for Ridgeway Fix, the co-op's repair site. Repair slots are 45 minutes each, and the workshop has three stands, so at most three bookings can overlap.
Got it. A slot is 45 minutes with a capacity of 3 per start time. Bookings open 14 days ahead by default.
14 days is fine. People keep no-showing though. If someone misses two bookings in a row, block online booking for 30 days.
Added a no-show counter on the member record. Two consecutive no-shows set booking_blocked_until to now plus 30 days. Staff can lift the block from the admin page.
Remind me what stack this is on, I lost track.
SvelteKit on the frontend, a small Go API, SQLite for storage, deployed on a single Hetzner VPS. Bookings live in the bookings table.
Reminders: send an SMS the evening before at 18:00, not email. Half our members never read email.
Customer reminders now go out by SMS at 18:00 the day before, through Twilio. Roughly one cent per message.
Kids' bikes: anyone under 16 needs a parent at the stand. Put a checkbox on the form.
Added a required 'guardian present' checkbox when the rider's age is under 16; the form won't submit without it.
And cancellations: free cancellation up to 2 hours before the slot.
Done: cancelling is free until 2 hours before the start; after that it counts as a no-show.

steps.statement: Repair slots are 45 minutes; the workshop has three stands, so up to three bookings per start time.
Online bookings open 14 days ahead.
Two consecutive no-shows block online booking for 30 days; staff can lift the block.
Ridgeway Fix runs on SvelteKit, a Go API and SQLite on one Hetzner VPS.
Customer booking reminders are sent by SMS at 18:00 the evening before, not by email.
Riders under 16 need a parent or guardian present at the stand; the booking form requires a checkbox.
Cancellation is free up to 2 hours before the slot; later it counts as a no-show.

steps.label: Ridgeway Fix: parts shop and payments
events: Next: a small parts shop. We sell inner tubes, brake pads, chains, and used parts stripped from donated bikes.
Created a products table with sku, name, price_cents, stock and condition (new or used). Used parts are one-off rows with stock 1.
Payments go through Stripe. No cash on the site; cash only at the counter.
Stripe Checkout handles online orders. The site says cash is accepted in person, but checkout has no cash option.
Inner tubes are $6, brake pads $9 a pair, chains $18.
Prices entered: inner tube 600 cents, brake pads 900 cents per pair, chain 1800 cents.
Orders are pickup only. We don't ship anything, not even small parts.
Shipping is disabled. Checkout only offers pickup at the workshop, and the confirmation email asks people to bring the order number.
Member discount: 10% off parts at checkout for logged-in active members. It does not apply to labour.
The Stripe webhook failed twice last night and orders stayed pending.
Cause: production was configured with the test-mode webhook signing secret. I rotated it to the live secret and added a retry job that re-checks pending orders every 10 minutes.
Unclaimed pickups, how long do we hold them?
Orders not picked up within 21 days are cancelled and refunded automatically, and the parts go back into stock.

steps.statement: Online payments go through Stripe only; cash is accepted only at the counter.
An inner tube costs $6.
Brake pads cost $9 a pair and a chain costs $18.
Parts orders are pickup only at the workshop; nothing is shipped.
Active members get 10% off parts, not labour.
Stripe webhooks failed because production used the test-mode signing secret; rotated, and a job re-checks pending orders every 10 minutes.
Orders not picked up within 21 days are cancelled, refunded and restocked automatically.

steps.label: Millbrook food bank: shifts
events: Food bank pantry opens Mondays 9 to 12 and needs four volunteers per shift. Volunteers who log 20 hours get a free lunch voucher.
Shift page created: Monday 9:00-12:00, four volunteer slots, and an hours counter that issues a lunch voucher at 20 hours.

steps.label: Lease renewal
events: The landlord wants $2,300 a month from March; we pay $1,850 now. I'm going to offer $2,000 with a three-year lease.
Recorded: current rent $1,850, landlord asks $2,300 from March, counter-offer $2,000 on a three-year lease.

steps.statement: Counter-offer the landlord $2,000 a month on a three-year lease.

steps.label: Ridgeway Fix: membership and pricing
events: Membership is $40 a year right now. The board voted to raise it to $50 from January 1, 2027.
Updated pricing.md: membership $50 a year for new and renewing members from 1 Jan 2027; renewals before that stay at $40.
Also a reduced membership for students and unemployed people, $20.
Added a reduced tier at $20 a year. It's self-declared, no document upload.
Tune-up for members goes from $25 to $30. Non-members stay at $45.
Changed pricing.md: member tune-up $30, non-member tune-up $45. Brake pads also moved to $10 a pair from the new supplier list.
Open shop night: members can use the stands and tools themselves on Wednesdays, free.
Added Wednesday 18:00-21:00 open shop to hours.md: members only, no booking needed, three stands.
Did we ever settle what happens to bikes left more than 60 days?
Yes, it's in the safety policy: bikes left over 60 days after a completed repair are donated to the youth programme after two reminder SMS.
Can we take donations through the site?
Added a donation page on the same Stripe account with suggested amounts of $10, $25 and $50. No tax receipts, since the co-op isn't a registered charity.

steps.content:
# Ridgeway Fix prices (from 1 January 2027)

Membership: $50 per year for new and renewing members from 1 Jan 2027 (renewals before then stay $40).
Reduced membership: $20 per year, students and unemployed people, self-declared.
Tune-up: members $30, non-members $45.
Parts: inner tube $6, brake pads $10 a pair, chain $18.

# Workshop hours

Tuesday and Thursday 17:00-20:00 (booked repairs).
Wednesday 18:00-21:00 open shop: members use stands and tools themselves, free, no booking.
Saturday 10:00-16:00 (booked repairs and walk-ins).
Closed on public holidays.

steps.statement: Membership costs $50 a year from 1 January 2027; renewals before then stay at $40.
Reduced membership is $20 a year for students and unemployed people, self-declared.
A tune-up costs $30 for members and $45 for non-members.
Wednesday 18:00-21:00 is open shop: members use stands and tools themselves, free, no booking.
Donations are taken through Stripe on the site; no tax receipts because the co-op is not a registered charity.

steps.label: Ridgeway Fix: volunteer rota
events: Volunteers sign up for shifts. Each Saturday needs at least two mechanics.
Built a rota page; a Saturday shows red when fewer than two mechanics are signed up.
Who gets told when a shift is understaffed?
Maya gets a Telegram message on Thursday at noon if Saturday still has fewer than two mechanics.
Use Telegram for staff things, SMS only for customers.
Noted: staff notifications go to the Telegram group 'Ridgeway crew'; customer reminders stay on SMS.
The SQLite file is copied nightly at 03:00 to Backblaze B2 and kept 30 days. A restore was tested on 14 October.
Volunteer hours: 20 hours of volunteering earns a free year of membership.
Added an hours counter per volunteer; at 20 logged hours their next membership renewal is free.

steps.statement: Each Saturday needs at least two mechanics on the rota.
Maya gets a Telegram alert Thursday at noon if Saturday has fewer than two mechanics.
Staff notifications go to the Telegram group 'Ridgeway crew'; customers get SMS.
The SQLite database is copied nightly at 03:00 to Backblaze B2 and kept 30 days.

steps.label: Ridgeway Fix: changes after the October review
events: Two hours is too short for cancellations, the stands sit empty. Free cancellation should end 24 hours before.
Free cancellation now ends 24 hours before the slot; later cancellations count as a no-show.
And open bookings 21 days ahead instead of 14, people plan around weekends.
The 18:00 reminder arrives while people commute. Send it at 20:00 instead.
Reminder SMS moved to 20:00 the evening before.
The Go API keeps growing in memory on the Hetzner box. Any idea?
An unclosed rows iterator in the parts search handler leaked connections; fixed with defer rows.Close(). Memory has stayed flat around 60 MB for two days.
Our supplier raised prices: sell inner tubes at $7.
Inner tube price is now $7 (700 cents) in the shop.
